items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was hanging out with Joe Louis and all these -- you know, just all the big wheels

ctx.x: Yeah. And a lot of things happened to me during that period. As you know, Lena and Lenny was a mixed marriage, right, and her manager was white so there were times man when neither one of them could go with Lena to various places, you know, for either appearances or et cetera, et cetera, et cetera. And as it was for quite a while there, I was the only black dude in her entourage, right. So I would have to go with Lena and doing so man, they put all this money in my hand, in my pockets -- and kept everything. And…
So you had a good rapport with Lena?
